```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggpubr)
library(airway)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(ggsci)
library(patchwork)
```

## Why Visualization Matters

Well-designed figures communicate results faster and more clearly than text.

## The Problem with Defaults
```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg)) + geom_boxplot()
```

## Before: Unstyled Plot (Airway)
```{r}
data("airway")
airway$dex <- as.factor(airway$dex)
airway$cell <- as.factor(airway$cell)
airway_df <- as.data.frame(colData(airway))

ggplot(airway_df, aes(x = cell, fill = dex)) + geom_bar(position = "dodge")
```

## After: Styled Bar Plot with ggpubr
```{r}
ggbarplot(airway_df, x = "cell", fill = "dex", palette = "jco",
          position = position_dodge()) +
  theme_pubr()
```

## Plot with P-values (mtcars)
```{r}
ggboxplot(mtcars, x = "cyl", y = "mpg", fill = "cyl", palette = "npg") +
  stat_compare_means()
```

## Faceting Example
```{r}
ggboxplot(mtcars, x = "gear", y = "mpg", fill = "gear") +
  facet_wrap(~cyl) +
  theme_pubr()
```

## Volcano Plot with Airway Data
```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSet(airway, design = ~ cell + dex)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)

EnhancedVolcano(res_df,
                lab = res_df$gene,
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'pvalue')
```

## Multiple Plots with ggarrange
```{r}
p1 <- ggboxplot(mtcars, x = "cyl", y = "mpg", fill = "cyl")
p2 <- ggscatter(mtcars, x = "hp", y = "mpg", color = "cyl")
ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"))
```

## Color Palettes: What Are Your Options?
- `ggsci`: nature, jama, lancet, npg
- `viridis`: colorblind-friendly gradients
- `RColorBrewer`: classic palettes (`Set1`, `Dark2`)
- `paletteer`: unified access to 100+ palettes

## Viridis Example
```{r}
ggscatter(mtcars, x = "wt", y = "mpg", color = "hp") +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```

## RColorBrewer Example
```{r}
ggboxplot(mtcars, x = "cyl", y = "mpg", fill = "cyl") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

## ggsci Example
```{r}
ggboxplot(mtcars, x = "cyl", y = "mpg", fill = "cyl") +
  scale_fill_nejm()
```

## Plot Makeover: Before
```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg)) + geom_boxplot()
```

## Plot Makeover: After
```{r}
ggboxplot(mtcars, x = "cyl", y = "mpg", fill = "cyl", palette = "npg") +
  stat_compare_means() +
  theme_pubr() +
  labs(title = "MPG by Cylinder Count", x = "Cylinders", y = "Miles per Gallon")
```

## Exporting Plots with `ggsave`
```{r eval=FALSE}
ggsave("my_clean_plot.png", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
